breakdown.description: `pimpleFoam` is a fluid solver and cannot compute the elastic deformation of the solid flap. A fluid-structure interaction (FSI) problem fundamentally requires two different sets of governing equations and thus two solvers (one for fluid, one for solid) that are coupled at their interface.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats the original errors verbatim: it uses 'pimpleFoam as the solid solver on a combined mesh' and 'single-region setup with no explicit displacement or traction exchange at the interface.' The ground truth requires a dedicated solid solver (solidDisplacementFoam) running on a separate solid region, with two-way FSI coupling exchanging displacement and traction each time step. The agent failed to identify or correct this fundamental inconsistency.
